The supplied coastal painting is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not a layout to copy. Match its warm opaque gouache, tactile brushwork, pigment and paper texture, dimensional natural forms, soft warm shadows, airy Hawaiian pink clouds, Thai-island turquoise and living greens. Cozy modest home or ordinary garden, never a luxury resort. Large clear focal subject with generous margins and quiet background. Keep the specified subject more prominent than scenery. No text, letters, numbers, calligraphy, fake Arabic, labels, arrows, frames, logos or watermarks. No people, human body parts, faces, portraits, divine figures, prophets, angels, supernatural light or imagined Hereafter. Ordinary sunlight is not a divine presence. No flat vectors, glossy 3D, photorealism, muddy grading or ominous darkness. One coherent scene, not a collage.
Subject: A small plain clay vessel receiving water, with a softened patch of living earth nearby.
Meaning constraints: An app-added reminder; no guaranteed cure or claim that every pain has an observable benefit.
Lighting: luminous gentle daylight, unless sunset or another time is explicitly specified. Soft middle tones rather than blinding white.
alt: A watering can pours clear water into a clay vessel beside a growing plant in a sunny garden.
reviewNotes: Visually checked against complete source entry and intended scene; composition and focal objects are clear.
